nodes.text: Perform physical exam; Perform imaging for staging; Perform and/or collect PSA and calculate PSADT; Estimate life expectancy (Principles of Life Expectancy Estimation [PROS-A]); Perform germline and somatic genetic testing (if not previously done); Obtain family history; Assess quality-of-life measures
